mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST) AS totalPosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_status = 'ACTIVE') AS activePosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blockedPosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_status = 'DELETED') AS deletedPosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT) AS totalComments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE comment_status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeComments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE comment_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blockedComments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE target_type IN ('post','comment') AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','DISMISSED')) AS pendingReports, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE target_type IN ('post','comment') AND status = 'RESOLVED' AND resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS resolvedReports30d FROM DUAL

choose.otherwise: AND ( cp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, lh.ip_address AS last_ip, cp.title, cp.content, cp.post_type, cp.region, cp.post_status, cp.view_count, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.report_count, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at, cp.tip_category, cpi.image_url AS thumb_url, IFNULL(ar.resolve_count, 0) AS author_resolve_count_30d FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE cpi ON cp.post_id = cpi.post_id AND cpi.sort_order = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ip_address ORDER BY login_at DESC), ',', 1) AS ip_address FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') GROUP BY user_idx ) lh ON lh.user_idx = cp.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_idx, COUNT(*) AS resolve_count FROM ( SELECT cp2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT cc2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) resolved_items GROUP BY author_idx ) ar ON ar.author_idx = cp.user_idx
ORDER BY
cp.report_count DESC, cp.created_at DESC cp.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(cp.post_id) FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_idx, COUNT(*) AS resolve_count FROM ( SELECT cp2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT cc2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) resolved_items GROUP BY author_idx ) ar ON ar.author_idx = cp.user_idx

SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, lh.ip_address AS last_ip, cp.title, cp.content, cp.post_type, cp.region, cp.post_status, cp.view_count, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.report_count, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at, cp.tip_category, cpi.image_url AS thumb_url, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.report_id FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE cp2.user_idx = cp.user_idx AND r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT r.report_id FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE cc2.user_idx = cp.user_idx AND r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) cnt ) AS author_resolve_count_30d FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE cpi ON cp.post_id = cpi.post_id AND cpi.sort_order = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ip_address ORDER BY login_at DESC), ',', 1) AS ip_address FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') GROUP BY user_idx ) lh ON lh.user_idx = cp.user_idx WHERE cp.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT cc.comment_id, cc.post_id, cp.title AS post_title, cc.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, lh.ip_address AS last_ip, cc.content, cc.comment_status, cc.like_count, cc.report_count, cc.created_at, cc.updated_at, cc.parent_comment_id, IFNULL(ar.resolve_count, 0) AS author_resolve_count_30d FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp ON cp.post_id = cc.post_id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cc.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ip_address ORDER BY login_at DESC), ',', 1) AS ip_address FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') GROUP BY user_idx ) lh ON lh.user_idx = cc.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_idx, COUNT(*) AS resolve_count FROM ( SELECT cp2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT cc2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) resolved_items GROUP BY author_idx ) ar ON ar.author_idx = cc.user_idx WHERE cc.post_id = #{postId} AND cc.comment_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE(cc.parent_comment_id, cc.comment_id), cc.comment_id

SELECT r.report_id, r.user_idx AS reporter_idx, u.user_id AS reporter_user_id, u.nickname AS reporter_nickname, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at, r.resolved_at, r.resolve_action FROM REPORT r LEFT JOIN USERS u ON r.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = #{postId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT cc.comment_id, cc.post_id, cp.title AS post_title, cc.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, lh.ip_address AS last_ip, cc.content, cc.comment_status, cc.like_count, cc.report_count, cc.created_at, cc.updated_at, cc.parent_comment_id, IFNULL(ar.resolve_count, 0) AS author_resolve_count_30d FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp ON cp.post_id = cc.post_id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cc.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ip_address ORDER BY login_at DESC), ',', 1) AS ip_address FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') GROUP BY user_idx ) lh ON lh.user_idx = cc.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_idx, COUNT(*) AS resolve_count FROM ( SELECT cp2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT cc2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) resolved_items GROUP BY author_idx ) ar ON ar.author_idx = cc.user_idx
ORDER BY
cc.report_count DESC, cc.created_at DESC cc.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(cc.comment_id) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cc.user_idx = u.user_idx
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_idx, COUNT(*) AS resolve_count FROM ( SELECT cp2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp2 ON r.target_id = cp2.post_id AND r.target_type = 'post' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT cc2.user_idx AS author_idx FROM REPORT r INNER JOIN COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 ON r.target_id = cc2.comment_id AND r.target_type = 'comment' WHERE r.status = 'RESOLVED' AND r.resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) resolved_items GROUP BY author_idx ) ar ON ar.author_idx = cc.user_idx
